entries.name: Cartoon ground impact
entries.description: 3 layer cartoon ground impact: shockwave ring + soft dust + debris. Mobile friendly, low overdraw.
entries.inline:
id: cartoon-ground-impact
intent: [impact, landing, destruction]
style: [cartoon, mobile, puzzle]
layers:
  - component: shockwave-ring
    texture: vfx://texture/ring-01/1
    delay: 0
    scale: 0.2 -> 1.8
    lifetime: 0.35
    blend: additive
  - component: soft-dust
    texture: vfx://texture/smoke-01/1
    delay: 0.03
    scale: 0.5 -> 1.4
    lifetime: 0.7
    blend: alpha
  - component: debris-burst
    texture: vfx://texture/ground-break-01/1
    delay: 0
    count: 8
    velocity: radial-outward
    lifetime: 0.5
notes:
  - Khong scale toan bo effect; tang lifetime cua dust thay vi scale
  - Overdraw: giua dust va ring khong chong qua nhieu

entries.name: Reward burst
entries.description: Chest opening reward burst: coin burst + confetti + sparkle orbit. For payout and level complete.
entries.inline:
id: reward-burst
intent: [reward, chest-open, level-complete]
style: [casual, cartoon]
layers:
  - component: coin-burst
    recipe: vfx://vfx/money-coins-burst/1
    delay: 0
    count: 12
    lifetime: 0.9
  - component: confetti
    recipe: vfx://vfx/confetti/1
    delay: 0.05
    count: 20
    lifetime: 1.4
  - component: sparkle-orbit
    recipe: vfx://vfx/sparkle-orbit/1
    delay: 0.1
    lifetime: 1.6
notes:
  - Them screen flash o client neu can emphasis

entries.name: Pickup pop
entries.description: Small satisfying pickup feedback: ring pop + sparkles + scale up fade out.
entries.inline:
id: pickup-pop
intent: [pickup, collect, coin]
style: [casual, mobile, puzzle]
layers:
  - component: ring-pop
    texture: vfx://texture/ring-01/1
    scale: 0.3 -> 1.2
    lifetime: 0.25
    blend: additive
  - component: sparkles
    texture: vfx://texture/sparkle-01/1
    count: 6
    lifetime: 0.4
notes:
  - Ngan, khong qua 0.5s de khong cham gameplay

entries.name: Damage hit spark
entries.description: Damage confirmation: short sparks + white flash circle. Readable at small scale.
entries.inline:
id: hit-spark
intent: [hit, damage, combat]
style: [action, stylized]
layers:
  - component: flash
    texture: vfx://texture/circle-02/1
    lifetime: 0.08
    scale: 0.6 -> 1.0
    blend: additive
  - component: sparks
    recipe: vfx://vfx/sparks/1
    count: 6
    lifetime: 0.2
notes:
  - Flash qua ngan; neu qua tinh dieu chinh tai client

entries.name: Soft smoke plume
entries.description: Layered soft smoke for aftermath, vent and barrel fire.
entries.inline:
id: soft-smoke-plume
intent: [smoke, aftermath, vent]
style: [stylized]
layers:
  - component: smoke-core
    texture: vfx://texture/smoke-01/1
    lifetime: 1.6
    scale: 0.4 -> 1.6
    alpha: 0.8 -> 0
  - component: fumes
    texture: vfx://texture/fumes-01/1
    delay: 0.1
    lifetime: 1.2
    rotation: random
notes:
  - Alpha blending, khong additive cho smoke

entries.name: Melee slash
entries.description: Melee hit confirmation: slash swipe + impact spark, one frame readable.
entries.inline:
id: melee-slash
intent: [slash, melee, hit]
style: [action, fantasy]
layers:
  - component: slash
    texture: vfx://texture/swipe-01/1
    lifetime: 0.15
    blend: additive
  - component: hit-spark
    recipe: vfx://recipe/hit-spark/1
    delay: 0.03
notes:
  - Dat slash theo normal cua surface neu co surface hit

entries.name: Projectile trail
entries.description: Streak trail behind bullets and magic bolts with fading tail.
entries.inline:
id: projectile-trail
intent: [trail, projectile, bullet]
style: [action, stylized]
layers:
  - component: streak
    texture: vfx://texture/bullet-trail-01/1
    lifetime: 0.25
    stretch-by-velocity: true
    alpha: 1 -> 0
notes:
  - Stretch theo velocity, khong fixed size

entries.name: Teleport gate
entries.description: Looping teleport portal: chipped ring + magic circle base + soft glow.
entries.inline:
id: teleport-gate
intent: [portal, teleport, gate]
style: [sci-fi, fantasy]
layers:
  - component: base-circle
    texture: vfx://texture/ritual-circle-01/1
    rotation: 0.4
    loop: true
  - component: ring
    texture: vfx://texture/portal-chipped-01/1
    loop: true
    blend: additive
  - component: glow
    texture: vfx://texture/soft-spot-01/1
    scale: 0.9
    loop: true
notes:
  - Loop khong spawn burst; dung local loi lai thay vi instantiate

entries.name: Radial burst technique
entries.description: Kỹ thuật bắn particle radial từ một điểm, có drag và scale-down theo lifetime. Nền tảng của impact, explosion, pickup burst.

entries.name: Shockwave ring technique
entries.description: Ring additive scale nhanh 0.2 -> 1.8 để tạo cảm giác lực cho ground impact và boss slam.

entries.name: Velocity stretched particle
entries.description: Kéo particle theo velocity để tạo vệt tracer, spark, debris bay nhanh.

entries.name: Flipbook smoke technique
entries.description: Texture Sheet Animation để smoke/cloud/fumes có chuyển động nội bộ, alpha blend.

entries.name: Dissolve particle technique
entries.description: Tan particle theo noise threshold để smoke/magic biến mất có cấu trúc, không tan đều.

entries.name: Mesh particle technique
entries.description: Dùng mesh thật (shell, coin, shard, lá) thay vì billboard cho debris 3D.

entries.name: Trail streak technique
entries.description: Vệt đuôi cho projectile, swoosh, dash after-image với width curve rơi về 0.

entries.name: Surface decal impact technique
entries.description: Căn impact theo surface normal (LookRotation) để decal dính tường/sàn nghiêng, tránh z-fighting.

entries.name: Depth fade soft particle
entries.description: Soft particle để smoke/fog không hiện đường cắt cứng khi gặp geometry.

entries.name: Soft dust component
entries.description: Lớp bụi mỏng alpha blend, lifetime dài hơn ring, dùng chung cho mọi ground impact.

entries.name: Shockwave ring component
entries.description: Ring additive render phía trên lớp dust, burst 1 particle lifetime 0.35s.

entries.name: Spark burst component
entries.description: 6 tia lửa velocity-stretch, gravity 0.6, cho metal hit và electric touch.

entries.name: Debris burst component
entries.description: 8 mảnh vỡ bắn radial, count thấp để không nuốt overdraw.

entries.name: Screen flash component
entries.description: Chớp trắng 0.08s để xác nhận hit hoặc reward emphasis.

entries.name: Glow particle component
entries.description: Đốm sáng additive mềm làm core cho heal, pickup, magic, portal.

entries.name: URP particle soft alpha
entries.description: Shader URP alpha blend có depth fade cho smoke chạm đất, tránh đường cắt cứng.

entries.name: URP particle additive glow
entries.description: Shader URP additive cho glow, spark, ring. Vertex/fragment tối giản, 1 texture sample.

entries.name: URP particle dissolve
entries.description: Dissolve theo noise với edge color, 2 texture sample, hợp mobile.

entries.name: SurfaceImpactController.cs
entries.description: Raycast va chạm, spawn VFX theo surface normal với offset chống z-fighting. Text-first, sửa trực tiếp được.

entries.name: VfxPool.cs
entries.description: Pool ParticleSystem, tránh Instantiate/Destroy khi burst effect dày.

entries.name: ParticleOrient.cs
entries.description: Helper xoay effect theo normal và offset khỏi surface, thay cho Quaternion.LookRotation viết tay.

entries.name: vfx-authoring skill
entries.description: Skill cloud: workflow search -> resolve -> fetch -> author -> validate -> publish, kèm text-first editing policy.

entries.name: Firework flipbook sheet 6x5 (CC0)
